blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Recent multimodal image generation models can take multiple images and textual instructions as input, enabling reference-based generation guided not only by text but also by visual instructions such as layouts, arrows, and pose cues.
However, existing benchmarks do not evaluate the joint setting in which multiple references must be composed under multiple and heterogeneous visual-instruction images.
To address this gap, we introduce VIF-Bench , a benchmark of 1,241 1{,}241 tasks designed to assess the edge of model capabilities in this joint setting by covering: (i) multi-reference generation (up to 7) under multiple heterogeneous visual instructions (up to 6), (ii) cases where reference images can potentially compete with visual instructions (e.g., a strongly posed subject vs. a target pose), and (iii) controlled comparison of visual instructions with text descriptions at different levels of specificity.
Using these capabilities, we uncover three findings:
(1) models face an adherence–artifact trade-off: once models reach stronger visual instruction adherence, stronger adherence tends to coincide with more instruction artifacts in generated images,
(2) visual instruction adherence tends to be lower on tasks whose reference images carry a salient state of the controlled attribute (e.g., a neon-lit subject under a light-direction instruction), most consistently for light and wind, and
(3) for models that can understand visual instructions, it is often better to provide visual constraints directly rather than describe them in text; when using text, a moderate level of detail works better than an exhaustive description.
VIF-Bench is released as an open benchmark to establish a basis for fair comparison in controllable multi-reference image generation.
blocks.zh:
近期的多模式图像生成模型可以将多个图像和文字指令作为输入,使基于参考的生成不仅能以文本为导向,而且能以布局,箭头,姿势提示等视觉指令为导向.
然而,现有的基准并不评价多种参考物必须包含在多种和多样的视觉指示图像中的联合设置。
为了弥补这一差距,我们提出了VIF-Bench , 基准为1,241 1{,}241项任务,目的是评估这种联合环境下模型能力的边缘,具体做法包括:(一) 在多种不同的视觉指令下多参考生成(最多7个);(二) 参考图像可能与视觉指令竞争的案例(例如,一个强烈的主体对一个目标姿势);(三) 将视觉指令与文字描述在不同具体程度的对照。
利用这些能力,我们发现了三个发现:
(1)模型面临遵守-艺术权衡:一旦模型获得更强的视觉指示遵守,更强的遵守往往与生成的图像中更多的指示文物相吻合,
(2)视觉指令的坚持度往往较低于其参考图像带有受控属性的显著状态(如光导指令下的霓虹灯主题)的任务,最一致的是光和风,以及
(3)对于能理解视觉指示的模型,往往最好直接提供视觉限制,而不是在文字中加以描述;在使用文字时,适度的详细程度比详尽的描述效果更好.
VIF-Bench作为开放式基准发布,以建立公平比较可控多参考图像生成的基础.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent image generation models, built on large multimodal LLM backbones, have advanced to a stage where they can generate not only from textual prompts but also by understanding multiple reference images and visual control marks ( Google DeepMind, 2025b ; Google DeepMind, 2025a ; OpenAI, 2025a ; OpenAI, 2025c ; Wu et al., 2025a ) .
Both multi-reference image generation ( Wu et al., 2025b ; Xia et al., 2025b ; Oshima et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , which recomposes subjects and backgrounds in new contexts, and visual-instruction-following generation ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Xia et al., 2025a ; Ghazanfari et al., 2025 ) , which interprets control marks such as layouts, masks, and arrows, share a common foundation: they both rely on the visual understanding capability of VLMs to interpret visual inputs at a semantic rather than pixel level.
In practical workflows, users want to specify not only what to generate but also how to compose it.
Given multiple references, users may specify placement via layouts, 3D orientation cues (rendered as pyramids), and global effects such as wind or lighting via arrows. Such control is directly relevant to a wide range of applications, including advertising ( Inoue et al., 2023 ; Morita et al., 2025 ) , virtual try-on ( Choi et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) , and content creation ( Ruiz et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
最近基于大型多式联运LLM主干线的图像生成模型已经发展到一个阶段,它们不仅可以从文字提示中生成,还可以通过理解多种参考图像和视觉控制标记(Google DeepMind,2025b;Google DeepMind,2025a;OpenAI,2025a;OpenAI,2025c;Wu等人,2025a).
多参考图像生成(Wu等人,2025年b;Xia等人,2025年b;Oshima等人,2026年b;Zhang等人,2026年b;Huang等人,2026年),这些图像在新的背景下对主题和背景进行了重新组合,视觉教学跟踪生成(Chen等人,2025年a; Zhang et al., 2026a; Xia et al., 2025a; Ghazanfari et al., 2025 ),解释布局,口罩,箭头等控制标志,具有共同的基础:两者都依靠VLM的视觉理解能力,在语义层面而非像素层面来解释视觉输入.
在实际工作流程中,用户不仅要具体说明生成什么,还要说明如何编译.
由于多次引用,用户可能通过布局指定放置,3D定向提示(降为金字塔),以及通过箭头指定风光等全局效应. 这种控制与广泛的应用直接相关,包括广告(Inoue等人,2023年;Morita等人,2025年),虚拟尝试。 (Choi等人,2024年;Hu等人,2026年),和内容创作(Ruiz等人,2022年;Zhou等人,2024年;徐等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
However, existing benchmarks evaluate multi-reference generation and visual control largely in isolation, and therefore do not fully capture the challenges that arise when the two are combined.
They do not evaluate how multiple independent subject references interact with multiple visual instruction images, especially when reference images interfere with the instructions.
Moreover, a further challenge arises from how these visual controls are represented in recent multimodal generators.
Unlike earlier approaches that rely on dedicated conditioning modules ( Zhang et al., 2023b ) , recent models ( Google DeepMind, 2025b ; OpenAI, 2025a ; Wu et al., 2025a ) interpret layouts, arrows, and orientation cues directly as image inputs.
This unified image-based interface introduces failure modes specific to visual instructions: models may reproduce the instruction marks themselves in the output or fail to preserve the intended constraint.
Existing benchmarks do not capture these failure modes in settings with multiple references and heterogeneous visual instructions.
blocks.zh:
然而,现有基准主要孤立地评价多参考生成和视觉控制,因此无法充分抓住两者合并后出现的挑战。
他们不评价多个独立主题引用如何与多个视觉指令图像相互作用,特别是在参考图像干扰指令时.
此外,这些视觉控制如何体现在最近的多式联运发电机中,也产生了另一个挑战。
与之前依赖专用调制模块的方法不同(Zhang等人,2023b),近期的模型. (Google DeepMind,2025b;OpenAI,2025a;Wu等人,2025a)将布局,箭头和方向提示直接解释为图像输入.
这种统一的基于图像的界面引入了针对视觉指令的失败模式:模型可能会在输出中复制指令本身标记或者无法保存预期的制约.
现有基准无法在有多种参考和多种视觉指示的环境下捕捉这些失败模式。

blocks.en:
To evaluate this setting, we introduce VIF-Bench , which jointly assesses multi-reference composition and heterogeneous visual-instruction following ( Figure 1 ).
VIF-Bench comprises 1,241 1{,}241 tasks designed to assess the edge of model capabilities in this joint setting by covering: (i) multi-reference generation (up to 7) under multiple heterogeneous visual instructions (up to 6), (ii) cases where reference images can potentially compete with visual instructions (e.g., a strongly posed subject vs. a target pose), and (iii) controlled comparison of visual instructions with text descriptions at different levels of specificity.
Using VIF-Bench, we identify three major findings:
(1) models face an adherence–artifact trade-off: once models reach stronger visual instruction adherence, stronger adherence tends to coincide with more instruction artifacts,
(2) visual instruction adherence tends to be lower on tasks whose reference images carry a salient state of the controlled attribute (e.g., a neon-lit subject under a light-direction instruction), most consistently for light and wind, and
(3) for models that can understand visual instructions, it is often better to provide visual constraints directly rather than describe them in text; when using text, a moderate level of detail works better than an exhaustive description.
These findings reveal limitations specific to jointly satisfying multiple references and heterogeneous visual constraints.
We release VIF-Bench as an open benchmark for evaluating controllable multi-reference image generation.

为了评估这一环境,我们引入了VIF-Bench,它联合评估了多种参考构成和随后的多种视觉指示(图1)。
VIF-Bench包含1,241 1{,}241项任务,目的是通过涵盖以下内容来评估这种联合环境下的模型能力的边缘: (一)多变量视觉指令下的多参考生成(最多7个), (二)参考图像可能与视觉指令竞争的案例(例如,一个强势的主体对一个目标姿势), (三)将视觉指令与文本描述在不同特殊级别上的对照.
利用VIF-Bench,我们确定了三个主要结论:
(1) 模型面临遵守 - 艺术上的权衡:一旦模型得到更强的视觉指示遵守,更强的遵守往往与更多的指示文物相吻合,
(2)视觉指令的坚持度往往较低于其参考图像带有受控属性的显著状态(如光导指令下的霓虹灯主题)的任务,最一致的是光和风,以及
(3)对于能理解视觉指示的模型,往往最好直接提供视觉限制,而不是在文字中加以描述;在使用文字时,适度的详细程度比详尽的描述效果更好.
这些调查结果表明,在共同满足多种参考和各种视觉限制方面存在着特定的局限性。
我们发布VIF-Bench作为评价可控多参考图像生成的开放基准.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Controllable Text-to-Image Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 可控文本到图像生成

blocks.en:
Diffusion models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in high-fidelity image synthesis ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Ho et al., 2020 ) .
Large pretrained diffusion models with textual conditioning, such as Stable Diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Podell et al., 2024 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) and FLUX ( Labs, 2024 ; Labs et al., 2025 ) , form the foundation of modern text-to-image generation.
To improve controllability, prior work has introduced additional conditioning channels, including spatial maps such as edges, depth, segmentation, and boxes ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2023b ; Li et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) , as well as identity-preserving reference conditioning through fine-tuning or adapters ( Ruiz et al., 2022 ; Ye et al., 2023 ; Mou et al., 2023 ) .
Recent multimodal image generation models further extend this direction by jointly processing text and image inputs within a unified framework.
For example, closed-source systems such as GPT-Image ( OpenAI, 2025a ; OpenAI, 2025c ; OpenAI, 2026 ) and Nano Banana ( Google DeepMind, 2025b ; Google DeepMind, 2025a ; Google DeepMind, 2026 ) enable integrated image generation and editing from mixed text-image prompts.
Similarly, open-source models such as Qwen-Image ( Wu et al., 2025a ) and FLUX Kontext ( Labs et al., 2025 ) demonstrate high-quality and flexible image generation and editing, and numerous unified generative models continue to emerge ( Wu et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Xia et al., 2025b ; Wu et al., 2025c ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) .
These advances show that image generation models are becoming increasingly capable of interpreting heterogeneous inputs, including reference images, styles, spatial layouts, and other visual cues ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Xia et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
VIF-Bench asks whether such models can actually follow these visual instructions when multiple reference subjects must be composed together.

blocks.en: 2.2 Benchmarks for Reference-Based Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 参考生成基准

blocks.en:
Benchmarks for reference-based image generation trace back to DreamBooth ( Ruiz et al., 2022 ) , which evaluates subject-driven generation conditioned on a single subject.
Subsequent studies have extended this setting to multiple references, introducing benchmarks for multi-reference generation ( Zong et al., 2024 ; Sushko et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Xia et al., 2025b ; Oshima et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
Other studies have extended this setting to visual instruction following.
MultiRef ( Chen et al., 2025a ) supports multiple reference images, but each task uses at most a single visual-instruction image. VIBE ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) covers regions, morphological cues such as pose and orientation, and arrows, and can combine multiple visual operations within a single annotated image. DreamOmni3 ( Xia et al., 2025a ) supports up to two visual-instruction images, but focuses only on scribble-based control.
Existing benchmarks therefore do not evaluate the joint setting targeted in this work, where multiple references must be composed simultaneously under several heterogeneous visual-instruction images.
See Appendix E for further discussion.
blocks.zh:
基于参考的图像生成基准可追溯到DreamBooth(Ruiz等人,2022年),该基准评价以单一主题为条件的主题驱动生成.
随后的研究将这一设定扩展到多种参考,引入了多参考生成的基准(Zong等人,2024年;Sushko等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年b;Xia等人,2025年b;大岛等人,2026年b;陈等人,2026年).
其他研究将这一背景扩展至随后的视觉教学。
MultiRef (Chen et al., 2025a) 支持多个参考图像,但每项任务最多使用单个视觉指示图像. VIBE(Zhang et al.,2026a)覆盖区域,姿势和定向等形态提示,以及箭头,可以将多个视觉操作组合在一个附加说明的图像内. DreamOmni3 (Xia et al., 2025a) 支持最多两幅视觉导引图像,但只注重以拼写为基础的控制.
因此,现有基准不评估这项工作所设定的共同设定,其中多个参考文献必须同时由若干不同的视觉指示图像组成。
见附录 E 供进一步讨论。

blocks.en: 3.1 Construction of VIF-Bench
blocks.zh: 3.1 建造VIF-Bench

blocks.en:
Image Collection. We construct the reference-image pool from both real and synthetic images.
Real images are collected from LAION-5B ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) , DreamBooth ( Ruiz et al., 2022 ) , and DreamOmni2 ( Xia et al., 2025b ) , while synthetic images are generated by Nano Banana ( Google DeepMind, 2025b ) and GPT-Image-1 ( OpenAI, 2025a ) .
Combining multiple data sources covers both common subject references and scarce attribute-specific references, such as hairstyle, makeup, facial expression, and object surface.
blocks.zh:
图片集. 我们从真实图像和合成图像中构建了参考图像池。
真实图像来自LAION-5B(Shuhmann等人,2022年),DreamBooth (Ruiz等人,2022年),和DreamOmni2(Xia等人,2025年b),而合成图像则由纳诺·香蕉(Google DeepMind,2025年b)和GPT-Image-1(OpenAI,2025年a)生成.
组合多个数据来源既涵盖常见的主题参考,也涵盖稀缺的属性特定参考,如发型,化妆,面部表情,以及物体表面.

blocks.en:
Category Classification. Following prior multi-reference image-generation benchmarks ( Xia et al., 2025b ; Oshima et al., 2026b ) , we hierarchically classify the collected images into three groups: Main Reference, Sub Reference, and Scene Context.
GPT-5 ( OpenAI, 2025b ) first automatically labels the images, which we then manually verify and correct.
Main Reference denotes the primary subject and consists of person , animal , object , and text .
Objects are further divided into versatile , indoor-only , and outdoor-only according to their plausible placement environments.
Sub Reference specifies attributes of a main subject: for people, we consider clothes , grooming (e.g., hairstyle and makeup), and facial expression ; for objects, we consider surface properties such as color and material.
Scene Context consists of scene style and background , which specify the overall appearance of the generated scene.
This hierarchy prevents semantically inconsistent task construction, such as assigning a facial-expression reference to an object.
blocks.zh:
分类。 按照先前的多参考图像生成基准(霞等人,2025年b;大岛等人,2026年b),我们按等级将收集的图像分为三类: 主要参考文献,分参考文献,以及场景背景.
GPT-5(OpenAI,2025b)首先会自动给图像贴上标签,然后我们手动验证和纠正.
主参考指主体,由人、动物、物体和文字组成。
物体还根据其合理的放置环境分为多功能、室内专用和室外专用。
SubReference具体规定了主体的属性:对于人们来说,我们考虑衣物,梳理(如发型和化妆),以及面部表情;对于物体来说,我们考虑色和物质等表面属性.
场景背景由场景风格和背景组成,其中指定了生成场景的整体外观.
这种等级结构可以防止在任务构建上存在强烈的不一致,例如为对象指定面部表情引用.

blocks.en:
Task Construction. Each task is constructed by combining hierarchically organized reference
images with visual instructions.
The input conditions are broadly divided into per-subject conditions,
associated with individual main subjects, and global conditions, associated
with the scene as a whole.
The former include sub-references, pose references, and 3D orientation
pyramids, while the latter include style modifiers, backgrounds, and
directional arrows.
Concretely, we (1) sample N m ​ a ​ i ​ n ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } N_{main}\!\in\!\{1,2,3,4\} main subjects together with their associated
references, (2) ask GPT-5 ( OpenAI, 2025b ) to propose a bounding-box
layout, per-subject 3D orientations, and wind/light arrow directions, which
are then rendered as visual-instruction images, and (3) generate a textual
instruction from the resulting reference structure using a deterministic
template.
These visual instructions are constructed to precisely specify
the target spatial and geometric conditions and to enable unambiguous
evaluation of instruction following, allowing task construction to scale to
a large benchmark.
To ensure task validity, all constructed tasks first undergo automatic
consistency checks and are then verified by Gemini ( Gemini Team, 2023 ) and human annotators; unnatural, ambiguous, or inconsistent tasks are
corrected or removed.
Pose references, orientation cues, and directional arrows follow
visual-control formulations used in prior visual-instruction benchmarks ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
Bounding-box layouts are likewise a standard spatial-control interface
widely used in prior work ( Li et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) .
Thus, while VIF-Bench procedurally generates visual instructions in a
controlled manner for reliable evaluation, the instruction representations
themselves follow established and practical visual-control paradigms.
We additionally construct three text-converted variants for a stratified 200-task subset,
enabling controlled comparison of instruction modality and specificity.
Further construction details are provided in

blocks.en:
Conflict Detection. We define conflict tasks as cases in which a reference image contains a salient state along an attribute that is also controlled by the corresponding visual instruction, creating the potential for the reference-implied state to compete with the requested control.
For example, if a person in the reference image is strongly side-lit while a light arrow specifies frontal illumination, the model must override the lighting implied by the reference and follow the visual instruction.
We identify conflict along four axes:
blocks.zh:
冲突侦测。 我们把冲突任务定义为一个参考图像中包含着一个也由相应的视觉指令所控制的属性的显著状态,从而创造出被引用的状态与所请求的控制竞争的潜力.
例如,如果在参考图像中一个人在光箭指定前照灯的同时是强烈的侧照,模型必须覆盖参考图中隐含的照明,并遵循视觉指示.
我们确定冲突有四个方面:

blocks.en: • Orientation conflict. A potential conflict is declared when the subject in the reference image has a clear facing direction, and the target orientation specified by the visual instruction departs substantially from it. Concretely, we target cases where the yaw difference between the reference and the instruction is large, or where the left/right facing direction is flipped. • Light conflict. A potential conflict is declared when the reference image contains a distinctive light source that strongly shapes the scene’s appearance—such as neon or moonlight—rather than ordinary daylight or uniform illumination, and the task includes a light visual instruction. • Wind conflict. We declare a potential conflict when the reference image contains elements whose appearance changes substantially under wind, such as hair or fabric, and the task includes a wind visual instruction. • Pose conflict. We declare a potential conflict when a person in the reference image is in a clear, distinctive pose and a pose visual instruction is assigned to that person.
blocks.zh: • 定向冲突。 当参考图像中的主题有明确的对面方向,而视觉指示中指定的目标方向则大大偏离时,就宣布了潜在的冲突. 具体地说,我们针对的是参考与指令之间的姚差很大,或者左/右对面方向被翻转的情况。 • 小规模冲突。 当参考图像中包含一个显著的光源,强烈地塑造了场景的外观——如霓虹灯或月光——而不是普通的日光或统一的照明,就宣告了潜在的冲突,任务包括一个光视觉指示. • 支助 风冲突. 我们宣称,当参考图像中包含其外观在风下发生巨大变化的元素,如毛发或织物,并且任务包括风视指令时,就存在潜在冲突. • 支助 庞斯冲突. 我们宣布,当参考图像中的人处于一个明确、独特的姿势,并且被指派给他一个姿势视觉指示时,就有可能发生冲突。

blocks.en:
We do not define a conflict criterion for layout because layout specifies the spatial arrangement of the overall scene rather than an intrinsic attribute of a reference image.
We first automatically label the reference-specific attributes required for these judgments with VLMs, then manually verify and correct them.
By design, these labels identify potential conflicts based on reference content: orientation can be compared directly against the target via a yaw estimate, whereas for light, wind, and pose we flag cases where the controlled attribute is salient in the reference and must be re-rendered to satisfy the visual instruction.
Further details for benchmark construction are shown in Appendix C .

我们没有定义布局的冲突标准,因为布局指定了整个场景的空间安排,而不是参考图像的内在属性.
我们首先将这些判断所需的参考特定属性自动标注为VLM,然后手动校验和校正.

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation Setting
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价

blocks.en:
Because large-scale human evaluation is prohibitively expensive, we adopt VLM-based evaluation, which is widely used in recent multimodal-generation benchmarks ( Ku et al., 2023 ; Na et al., 2024 ; Oshima et al., 2025 ) .
Gemini 2.5 Flash ( Gemini Team, 2023 ) and GPT-5 ( OpenAI, 2025b ) independently evaluate all generated images, and we report their average score.
Following prior reference-based image-generation benchmarks ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Oshima et al., 2026b ) , we retain the core evaluation dimensions of instruction following, reference consistency, and overall image quality.
We further separate overall image quality into Scene Coherence and Visual Quality for more fine-grained assessment.
Accordingly, each image is evaluated on a 10-point scale along six criteria: Text Instruction Following, Reference Consistency, Vision Instruction Adherence, Visual Instruction Cleanliness, Scene Coherence, and Visual Quality.
Text Instruction Following and Reference Consistency assess adherence to the textual instruction and preservation of reference subjects, while Scene Coherence and Visual Quality assess overall scene consistency and perceptual quality.
To capture failure modes specific to image-based visual control in recent multimodal image generation models ( Google DeepMind, 2025b ; OpenAI, 2025a ; Wu et al., 2025a ) , we separately evaluate Vision Instruction Adherence and Visual Instruction
Cleanliness.
The former measures whether the generated image satisfies the constraints specified by the visual instructions, while the latter measures whether instruction elements such as layout boxes and arrows remain in the output.
blocks.zh:
由于大规模人类评价费用高昂,我们采用了基于自愿终止措施的评价,这种评价被广泛用于最近的多式联运基准(Ku等人,2023年;Na等人,2024年;大岛等人,2025年)。

遵循先前基于参考的图像生成基准(Ye等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年b;Oshima等人,2026年b),我们保留了指令的核心评价方面,参考一致性和整体图像质量。
我们进一步将整体图像质量分为场景一致性和视觉质量,以便进行更细致的评估。
因此,每个图像按以下6个标准按10个尺度进行评估:文本指示跟踪、参考一致性、视觉指示遵守性、视觉指示清洁性、场景一致性和视觉质量。

( Right ) Scores versus the number of visual-instruction images.
In contrast to the number of references, Adherence changes far less with more visual instructions and depends mostly on the generator itself, while additional visual instructions mainly lower Text Instruction Following.
blocks.zh:

更多的参考文献将所有三项标准都降低,并将开放量模型推向参考一致性和视觉指示遵守度的接近层,而封闭的模型则基本上保留了参考一致性;在封闭模型中,Nano Banana Pro保留了大部分的遵守度,而GPT-Image-1.5则急剧下降。

与引用次数相比,坚持性变化在视觉指令较多的情况下要少得多,主要依赖于生成器本身,而额外的视觉指令主要低于文本指令跟随.

blocks.en:
Figure 6: ( Left ) Visual Instruction Adherence on conflict and no-conflict subsets for Orientation, Light, Wind, and Pose. Conflict generally reduces adherence, with particularly pronounced gaps for Light and Wind; for Pose, the reduction is visible only for generators with non-trivial adherence.
( Right ) Comparison between visual instructions (VIs) and text-converted instructions at different levels of granularity for Nano Banana Pro.
VI and TI Dense approximately match information content and primarily differ in modality; TI Medium and TI Sparse progressively remove information.
All conditions are evaluated against the original VI, so the comparison among text variants measures recovery of the original constraint under increasing textual abstraction.
blocks.zh:
图6:(左)关于冲突和非冲突子集的视觉指示,用于定向、光、风和Pose。 冲突一般会减少坚持性,光和风尤其明显;对Pose来说,只有坚持非三边的发电机才明显减少。
(右边) Nano Banana Pro的视觉指示(VI)和不同颗粒度的文本转换指示的比较。

Figure 7: Qualitative examples of VIF-Bench.

( Right ) Reference–visual-instruction conflict in pose or lighting results in ignorance of visual instructions.

图7:VIF-Bench的定性实例。

blocks.en: 4.2 Effect of the Number of References and Visual Instructions
blocks.zh: 4.2 参考和视觉指示数目的效果

blocks.en:
Figure 5 plots scores against the number of references and visual-instruction images for four representative generators (full results in Appendix F.2 ).
Adding references degrades all three criteria.
With a single reference, open-weight models trail closed ones only modestly in Reference Consistency and Visual Instruction Adherence, but with five or more references both fall to near the floor of the scale, whereas closed models largely retain their Reference Consistency.
The large open/closed gap in these criteria in Table 2 thus stems mainly from multi-reference tasks.
Closed models also diverge: Nano Banana Pro retains much of its Adherence, whereas GPT-Image-1.5 drops sharply, and this is where the adherence–artifact trade-off of Section 4.1 emerges (Appendix F.2 ).
blocks.zh:
图5图比对4台具有代表性发电机的参考文献和视觉指示图像数(附录F.2的全部结果)。
添加参考文献会降低所有三项标准。
单凭一个参考文献,开放量级模型小径仅略微关闭在参考一致性和视觉指示遵守度中,但有5个或5个以上参考文献都接近比例尺底部,而封闭的模型则基本上保留其参考一致性。
因此,表2中这些标准存在很大的开放/封闭差距,这主要源于多参考任务。
封闭模型也存在差异: 纳诺香蕉 Pro保留了大部分的加入,而GPT-Image-1.5则大幅下降,这就是第4.1节的加入-艺术取舍(附录F.2 )的出现之处。

blocks.en:
In contrast, from one to three visual instructions, Adherence remains nearly unchanged for both closed models and stays low for both open-weight models, whereas the same increase in references lowers it substantially.
Adherence thus reflects each generator’s ability to interpret visual instructions more than their number; additional ones instead mainly lower Text Instruction Following.
blocks.zh:
相比之下,从一个到三个视觉指示,闭合模型的遵守率几乎保持不变,两个开量模型的遵守率都很低,而参考文献的同样增加大大降低了遵守率。
因此,遵守情况反映了每个生成器比其数量更能解释视觉指令;其他的则主要是以下的文本指令。

blocks.en: 4.3 Reference–Visual-Instruction Conflict
blocks.zh: 4.3 参考-视觉-指导冲突

blocks.en:
Figure 6 ( Left ) compares Visual Instruction Adherence between conflict and no-conflict subsets for each instruction type.
Across the representative generators, the conflict subsets generally show lower adherence, although the gap varies by instruction type.
The gap is largest for Light and Wind and smaller for Orientation.
For Pose, the reduction appears in the generators that attain non-trivial adherence in the first place (Nano Banana Pro and GPT-Image-1.5), whereas the open-weight models already score near the floor on pose tasks regardless of conflict, leaving little room for a further drop.
These results suggest that salient reference attributes may make it harder to follow visual instructions targeting the same attribute.
Qualitative examples in Figure 7 ( Right ) illustrate cases where models retain pose or lighting cues from the reference rather than fully following the target visual instruction.
Further per-generator results and conflict-subset statistics are provided in Appendix F.1 .
blocks.zh:
图6 (左) 比较每个指令类型的可视指令 冲突与无冲突子集之间的坚持性 。
在整个具有代表性的生成器中,冲突子集一般显示遵守率较低,尽管差异因指令类型而异。
光和风的差距最大,方向差距较小。
对Pose来说,这种减少出现在最初达到非三进制的发电机(Nano Banana Pro和GPT-Image-1.5)中,而开放式模型已经接近地板,不论冲突如何,都以任务布局,几乎没有再下降的余地。
这些结果表明,突出的参考属性可能使针对同一属性的视觉指示更难执行.
图7(右)中的定性例子说明了模型保留参考文献中的姿势或照明提示而不是完全遵循目标视觉指示的情况。
附录F.1提供了进一步的再生结果和冲突子集统计数据。

blocks.en: 4.4 How Should Visual Constraints Be Specified?
blocks.zh: 4.4 如何确定视觉限制?

blocks.en:
Visual constraints can vary in representation and level of detail, which may affect how well models follow them.
We first isolate representation modality by comparing the original visual instruction (VI) with TI Dense, which verbalizes nearly all information encoded by the VI.
For Nano Banana Pro, which shows strong VI-adherence in VIF-Bench, the original VI achieves higher adherence than its dense textual counterpart ( Figure 6 ; Right ).
This suggests that, when a model can reliably interpret visual instructions, presenting precise spatial or geometric constraints can be more effective than verbalizing the same information.
In contrast, GPT-Image-1.5 benefits from text conversion, indicating that the preferred modality depends on the model’s VI-understanding capability (Appendix F.3 ).
blocks.zh:
视觉限制在表现和详细程度上可能有所不同,这可能影响模型遵循的程度。
我们首先通过比较原视觉指示(VI)和TI Dense来隔离表现方式,后者将几乎所有由VI编码的信息口头化.
Nano Banana Pro在VIF-Bench中显示出了强烈的VI-A-遵守,而最初的VI的遵守程度高于其密集的文本对应方(图6;右)。
这表明,当一个模型能够可靠地解释视觉指示时,给出精确的空间或几何限制比对同一信息进行口头解释更有效.
相比之下,GPT-Image-1.5从文本转换中获益,表明首选模式取决于模型的VI理解能力(Appendix F.3 ).

blocks.en:
We next consider a practical textual interface, where users may not verbalize every coordinate, angle, or joint configuration in a VI.
We progressively abstract TI Dense into TI Medium and TI Sparse.
These variants intentionally contain different amounts of information, and we evaluate all outputs against the original VI as an oracle specification.
The score measures how well each textual representation recovers the original constraint, rather than how closely it adheres to the provided text.
TI Medium recovers the original constraint better than TI Dense despite omitting fine-grained values, suggesting that reducing verbal complexity can offset some information loss.
With TI Sparse, however, further simplification removes information needed to convey the original intent.
Visual instructions thus offer a compact way to convey precise constraints without requiring exhaustive verbalization, while textual instructions require a balance between detail and abstraction.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来考虑一个实用的文字界面,用户可能不会在VI中将每个坐标,角度,或联合配置进行口头化.
我们逐渐把TI Dense 抽象为TI 中型和TI Sparse.
这些变体有意包含不同数量的信息,我们根据原始VI来评价所有产出,作为甲骨文规格.
得分衡量每种文字表述如何很好地恢复原先的制约,而不是衡量它在多大程度上遵守所提供的文字。
TI Midium尽管省略了精细的刻度值,但仍比TI Dense更好地恢复了原有的制约,这表明降低口头复杂性可以抵消一些信息损失.
然而,通过TI Sparse,进一步简化删除了传达原始意图所需的信息.
因此,视觉指示提供了一种简洁的方式来传达准确的制约,而不需要详尽无遗的口头说明,而文字指示则需要细节和抽象之间的平衡。

blocks.en: 4.5 Agentic Multi-step Generation
blocks.zh: 4.5 多步骤生成

blocks.en:
We investigate whether VIF-Bench tasks can be solved more reliably by decomposing them into simpler sub-tasks.
GPT-5 plans 2 2 – 4 4 sub-tasks and assigns a subset of the reference images to each; at every step, the generator receives the previous output, the sub-task instruction, and the newly assigned references, and its output is passed on.
The final image is evaluated against the original task.
This pipeline raises Nano Banana Pro’s average score from 6.96 6.96 to 7.40 7.40 but slightly lowers GPT-Image-1.5’s, from 7.60 7.60 to 7.53 7.53 .
For both generators, however, the per-criterion changes follow the adherence–artifact pattern of Section 4.1 : Visual Instruction Cleanliness rises (Nano Banana Pro: 6.27 6.27 to 8.37 8.37 ; GPT-Image-1.5: 9.39 9.39 to 9.80 9.80 ) while Visual Instruction Adherence falls (Nano Banana Pro: 5.67 5.67 to 5.09 5.09 ; GPT-Image-1.5: 4.57 4.57 to 4.43 4.43 ), indicating that the tension between the two objectives also holds within a single generator and that decomposition moves along the trade-off rather than escaping it.
Splitting the references across steps further reduces Reference Consistency by weakening subject grounding within each step.
The benefit of agentic decomposition therefore depends on the generator and the criterion.
blocks.zh:
我们调查VIF-Bench任务是否能够通过将它们分解成更简单的子任务来更可靠地解决.
GPT-5计划2 2 – 4 4 个子任务,并为每个子任务分配一个子集的参考图像;在每个步骤上,生成器都收到之前的输出,子任务指令,以及新分配的参考,其输出被传递.
最终图像根据原任务进行评估.
这条管道升起 纳诺香蕉 Pro的平均得分从6.96 6.96到7.40 7.40,但略低于GPT-Image-1.5,从7.60 7.60到7.53 7.53.
然而,对于这两台发电机,每个标准的变化都遵循第4.1节的遵守方式: 视觉指示清洁度上升 (Nano Banana Pro:6.27 6.27 - 8.37 8.37;GPT-Image-1.5:9.39 9.39 - 9.80 9.80),而视觉指令遵守率下降(Nano Banana Pro:5.67 5.67 - 5.09 5.09;GPT-Image-1.5:4.57 4.57 - 4.43 4.43),表明两个目标之间的紧张关系也存在于一个发电机内,分解沿权衡而不是逃脱。
将参考书目分成各个步骤,通过削弱每一步骤内的主题基础,进一步降低了参考一致性。
因此,剂分解的好处取决于发生器和标准。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
VIF-Bench enables systematic evaluation of multi-reference generation under heterogeneous visual constraints, including potential reference–VI conflicts and controlled VI––TI comparisons at different levels of specificity.
Our evaluation reveals three findings: current models exhibit an adherence–artifact tension when following visual instructions; visual instruction adherence tends to be lower when references carry a salient state of the controlled attribute; and the best representation of a visual constraint depends on the model’s VI capability, with direct VIs benefiting strong VI-following models and intermediate textual specificity outperforming exhaustive verbalization.
Together, these results highlight both the remaining limitations of multimodal generators and the importance of how visual constraints are represented.
blocks.zh:
VIF-Bench能够在不同的视觉限制下系统评价多参考生成,包括潜在的参考-VI冲突以及控制下的VIQTI在不同特定级别的比较。
我们的评价揭示了三个结论:当前的模型在遵循视觉指示时表现出了守法的-艺术的张力;当参考物具有受控属性的显著状态时,视觉指示的守法性往往较低;视觉约束的最佳表现取决于模型的VI能力,直接VI有利于强大的VI跟随模型,中间文本特殊性优于详尽无遗的口头表达。
这些结果共同突出了多式联运发电机的其余局限性以及视觉限制如何体现的重要性。

blocks.en: AI use statement
blocks.zh: AI 语句

blocks.en:
In this work, we used generative AI tools to create synthetic datasets and implement methods.
In particular, generative models are integral components of the VIF-Bench pipeline described in the paper: Nano Banana and GPT-Image-1 generate part of the synthetic reference-image pool; GPT-5 proposes visual instructions (bounding-box layouts, 3D orientations, and wind/light arrow directions) and pre-labels reference attributes; and GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Qwen3-VL-32B serve as VLM judges in the evaluation protocol.
We have not used generative AI tools to develop theoretical models or conceptual frameworks, to propose or refine hypotheses, to design research methodology or experiments, or to interpret results, and the remaining required-disclosure tasks (formulating mathematical claims, providing critical ingredients for proving mathematical claims, and assisting in the writing of proofs) are not applicable to this work.
Additionally, we used generative AI tools to create and modify scientific figures and images, create and edit software code, create research artifacts, and draft parts of the manuscript.
We have reviewed all AI-assisted work.
All AI-proposed tasks and labels underwent automatic consistency checks and were verified and corrected by human annotators; the VLM-based judging protocol was validated against human ratings on a 168-image subset, including an open-source judge; AI-assisted code was verified and tested for correctness by the authors; and all AI-drafted text and figures were reviewed and edited by the authors, with technical claims checked against the experimental results.
We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims, and artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.

在这项工作中,我们使用基因AI工具来创建合成数据集和实施方法.
特别是,基因模型是论文描述的VIF-Bench管道的组成部分:纳米香蕉和GPT-Image-1生成部分合成的参考图像池;GPT-5提出视觉指令(边框布局,3D方向,以及风/光箭方向)和前标签参考属性;以及GPT-5,双子座2.5闪光,以及Quen3-VL-32B在评价协议中担任VLM判断器.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: VIF-Bench is a diagnostic benchmark intended to advance the controllability and reliability of multi-reference image generation by exposing failure modes that are invisible to generic image-quality metrics, with positive implications for applications such as advertising, virtual try-on, and content creation, where faithfulness to user-specified composition matters more than aesthetic polish. At the same time, like any benchmark in the image-generation space, VIF-Bench indirectly contributes to the broader ecosystem of generative imaging, which carries well-known misuse risks, including deepfakes, non-consensual intimate imagery, identity fraud, and visual misinformation that can manipulate public opinion or harass individuals. The very capabilities VIF-Bench is designed to evaluate—faithful placement of specified subjects, control over facing direction, and adherence to global lighting and force cues— also make synthetic media more convincing and, therefore, more dangerous when misused. We will mitigate this risk by releasing the benchmark as an evaluation-only resource that excludes model weights, and new generative tooling, and by building it on references drawn from existing public datasets, so that no new identifiable persons are introduced.
blocks.zh: VIF-Bench是一个诊断性基准,旨在通过曝光一般图像质量度量标准所看不见的故障模式,来推进多参考图像生成的可控性和可靠性,对广告,虚拟尝试,内容创建等应用产生正面影响,对用户特定成分的忠诚度比美学油光更重要. 同时,像图像生成空间中的任何基准一样,VIF-Bench间接地促进了基因成像的更广泛的生态系统,它带有众所周知的误用风险,包括深假,未经同意的亲密图像,身份欺诈,以及可以操纵舆论或骚扰个人的视觉错误. VIF-Bench的能力旨在评估——忠实地安排特定对象、控制方向、坚持全球照明和强力提示——也使合成媒介在被滥用时更有说服力,因而更加危险。 我们将减轻这一风险,释放这一基准,将其作为排除模型加权和新的基因工具的仅作为评价资源,并以现有公共数据集的参考文献为基础,从而不引入新的可识别人员。

blocks.en: Appendix A Results of Qwen3-VL Judge
blocks.zh: Quen3-VL法官的结果

blocks.en:
In Section 4 , we report evaluation results based on the average scores assigned by Gemini 2.5 and GPT-5.
As shown in Section 4.6 , Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) exhibits a high level of agreement with human evaluations, with correlations comparable to those of GPT-5 ( OpenAI, 2025b ) and Gemini 2.5 ( Gemini Team, 2023 ) (see Table 3 ).
While we evaluate the closed-source judges using fixed API versions, their continued availability and exact reproducibility may still depend on external API access.
We therefore additionally evaluate all outputs with Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct, a fixed-version open-weight model, to provide a fully reproducible evaluation setting. This also makes the benchmark more accessible to researchers without access to proprietary VLM APIs.
blocks.zh:
在第4节中,我们根据双子座2.5和GPT-5分配的平均分数报告评价结果。
如第4.6节所示,Quen3-VL-32B-Instructionct(Bai等人,2025年)与人类评价高度一致,其相关性可与GPT-5(OpenAI,2025b)和双子座2.5(双子座团队,2023年)相似(见表3)。
虽然我们使用固定的API版本评价封闭源代码法官,但其持续可用性和准确的可复制性仍可能取决于外部API访问.
因此,我们还用Qune3-VL-32B-Instruct(固定版开放量模型)对所有产出进行评价,以提供一个完全可复制的评价环境。 这也使得无法获取专有VLM API的研究人员更容易获得基准.

blocks.en:
Table 4 reports the scores obtained using Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct as the sole evaluator, following the same scoring procedure described in Section 3.3 .
The generator ranking is preserved except for a swap between DreamOmni2 and FLUX.1 Kontext, which differ by less than 0.1 under every judge.
The adherence–artifact trade-off is also reproduced within each generator.
With multi-step decomposition, Visual Instruction Cleanliness rises (Nano Banana Pro: from 6.60 to 8.42; GPT-Image-1.5: from 9.48 to 9.85) while Visual Instruction Adherence falls (Nano Banana Pro: from 7.74 to 7.08; GPT-Image-1.5: from 7.90 to 7.19).
Likewise, the update from GPT-Image-1 to GPT-Image-1.5 raises Adherence from 7.40 to 7.90 while lowering Cleanliness from 9.81 to 9.48.
Qwen3-VL is more lenient on Adherence and compresses the four closed models into a 0.5-point band (7.40–7.90), so it does not resolve the cross-family gap on which GPT-5 and Gemini independently agree (see Table 6 ); among the three judges, only GPT-5 reaches human–human agreement on this criterion (0.76/0.72 vs. 0.75/0.74; Table 7 ).

blocks.en: C.1 LAION-5B Image Filtering
blocks.zh: C.1 LAION-5B 图像过滤

blocks.en:
For reference images sourced from LAION-5B ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) , we applied the filtering procedure below.
First, to remove images that are unsuitable as references in terms of composition (foreground subject too small, or visually unclear), we ran YOLOv12 ( Tian et al., 2025 ) object detection on every image, and then performed semantic segmentation with SAM ( Ravi et al., 2025 ) conditioned on the detected bounding boxes. We discarded an image if it satisfied any of the following: (i) the area of the bounding box covers less than 2% of the entire image, (ii) the segmented region inside the bounding box covers less than 30% of the box, or (iii) the CLIP similarity ( Radford et al., 2021 ) between the YOLO-predicted class name and the bounding-box region is below 20. On the other hand, we retained images with no detected objects, since we judged them useful as references for backgrounds or style-level content. After this stage, about 48% of the original images remained.
Next, to remove images inappropriate as references (unsafe content, charts, screenshots of system messages, etc.), we combined automatic screening with Gemini ( Gemini Team, 2023 ) and human review. For inappropriate content, we specifically targeted hate, harassment, violence, self-harm, sexual content, nudity, shocking content, illegal activity, and other distressing material, ultimately excluding about 3% of the remaining images. We also manually verified and removed near-duplicate synthetic images.
blocks.zh:
对于来自LAION-5B(Shuhmann等人,2022年)的参考图像,我们采用了下面的过滤程序。
首先,为了删除在构成上不适宜用作参考的图像(前题太小,或视觉不清),我们在每个图像上运行YOLOv12(Tian等人,2025年)对象检测,然后与SAM(Ravi等人,2025年)进行语义分解,条件是检测到的边框。 我们丢弃了一个图像,如果它满足以下任何一种情况的话:(一) 边框的面积覆盖整个图像的2%以下;(二) 边框内的片段覆盖不到盒子的30%,或者(三) YOLO 预设的类名称与边框区域之间的CLIP相似性(Radford等人,2021年)低于20. 另一方面,我们保留了没有被检测到的物体的图像,因为我们判断这些图像作为背景或样式级内容的参考是有用的。 在这个阶段之后,大约48%的原始图像仍然留存.
其次,为了删除不适当的图像作为参考(不安全的内容,图表,系统信息截图等),我们将自动放映与双子座(双子座团队,2023年)和人文评论相结合. 对于不恰当的内容,我们特别针对仇恨,骚扰,暴力,自我伤害,性内容,裸露,令人震惊的内容,非法活动,以及其他令人痛苦的材料,最终排除了大约3%的剩余图像. 我们还手动核实并移除了近似重复的合成图像。

blocks.en: C.2 Language Coverage of Text References
blocks.zh: C.2 文本参考资料的语言覆盖范围

blocks.en: For the main text reference, we follow the design of MultiBanana ( Oshima et al., 2026b ) and cover three languages: English, Chinese, and Japanese. This lets us diversify not only typography but also language itself, both in tasks where text is the primary reference and in tasks where typography serves as a secondary reference.
blocks.zh: 关于主要文字参考,我们遵循MultiBanana(大岛等人,2026b)的设计,并涵盖三种语言:英语,汉语,日语. 这使我们不仅使打字工作多样化,而且使语言本身多样化,无论是在将文本作为主要参考的任务中,还是在将打字作为次要参考的任务中。

blocks.en: C.3 Visual Instruction Construction
blocks.zh: C.3 视觉教学建筑

blocks.en: Here we describe, for each visual instruction in our benchmark, the construction procedure and design choices we made to make the visual instructions easy to read as control signals and prevent them from leaking into the final generated image.
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们描述了我们基准中的每个视觉指示,我们所做的建造程序和设计选择,使视觉指示易于作为控制信号读取,防止它们泄露到最终生成的图像中.

blocks.en:
Layout. For each main reference, we let GPT-5 ( OpenAI, 2025b ) propose a 2D bounding box, which is then drawn as a colored rectangle on a 1024 × \times 1024 canvas. In the proposal, we instruct the model to avoid collage-like or grid-like arrangements, prefer overlap, depth cues, and a common ground plane, ensure that no single box covers the entire canvas, and keep a margin of at least 0.05 from the canvas edges, so that the final generated image reads as a single natural picture. This prevents the layout instruction from being interpreted as an instruction to “tile” images side by side, which would make the final output look like a collage or split panel.
We also require the proposed bounding boxes to be tied to the canonical image index of the input ( Image_0 , Image_1 , …). This prevents the correspondence between subjects and visual instructions from drifting in tasks with multiple references.
blocks.zh:
版图 对于每个主要参考,我们让GPT-5(OpenAI,2025b)提出一个2D边框,然后在1024×\times 1024画布上画成彩色矩形. 在提案中,我们指示模型避免类似拼接或网格式的安排,更喜欢重叠,深度提示,以及一个共同的地面平面,确保没有单个的盒子覆盖整个画布,并且从画布边缘至少保持0.05的边距,这样最终生成的图像会读作单一的自然图片. 这使得布局指示无法被解释为一个将图像并排“瓦片”的指示,这将使最后的输出看起来像一个拼接或分裂面板。
我们还要求将提议的边框与输入的条形图像索引(Image_0,Image_1,. 这使得主体与视觉指示之间的通信无法在任务中漂移,并有多个参考.

blocks.en:
Orientation. For each main reference whose orientation is meaningful (i.e., person, animal, or object), we have GPT-5 propose a 3D facing direction in terms of two angles: yaw and pitch. Here, yaw = 0 ∘ =0^{\circ} corresponds to the viewer/camera direction, + 90 ∘ +90^{\circ} to screen-right, − 90 ∘ -90^{\circ} to screen-left, and 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} to the back, while positive pitch denotes upward and negative pitch downward. Based on these angles, we render a single 3D square pyramid (black background, gray fill, yellow-green outline) for each main reference. The pyramid’s square base corresponds to the front of the subject, and the apex to the back.
In the proposal, we impose the visibility constraints | y ​ a ​ w | < 60 ∘ |yaw|<60^{\circ} , | p ​ i ​ t ​ c ​ h | < 60 ∘ |pitch|<60^{\circ} , and | y ​ a ​ w | + | p ​ i ​ t ​ c ​ h | ≤ 75 ∘ |yaw|+|pitch|\leq 75^{\circ} , and additionally forbid near-frontal angles ( | y ​ a ​ w | < 15 ∘ |yaw|<15^{\circ} and | p ​ i ​ t ​ c ​ h | < 15 ∘ |pitch|<15^{\circ} ). This excludes angles where the pyramid collapses visually and the orientation becomes unreadable, and restricts the visual instruction to a range that remains interpretable.
We also make the role separation explicit: when a layout is available, the apex anchor uses the center of the layout box, and when no layout is available, the anchor position is purely for rendering and does not encode placement. This keeps orientation limited to facing direction, separate from layout’s placement role.

blocks.en:
Wind and light arrow. We let GPT-5 propose, in normalized canvas coordinates, the start and end points of a 2D directed arrow. Wind arrows are drawn in cyan and light arrows in yellow; when both are present, they are drawn together on a single arrow image. The semantics are: for wind, the start denotes the wind source, and the end denotes the direction the wind blows toward; for light, the start denotes the light source, and the end denotes where the light falls.
In the proposal, we constrain the arrow length to be ≥ 0.4 \geq 0.4 and require it to stay ≥ 0.05 \geq 0.05 inside the canvas edges. This is because arrows that are too short or squashed against the edge are hard to read as directional cues, and because wind and light arrows can coexist in the same image, whereas fixing color and tail/head semantics prevents confusion between the two.
blocks.zh:
风光箭射. 我们让GPT-5在规范的帆布坐标中提出一个2D定向箭头的始末点. 风箭用青色画,光箭用黄色画;两者都在场时,均用单箭头图案画在一起. 语义是:对于风,起始表示风源,末表示风吹向的方向;对于光,起始表示光源,末表示光源落地.
在提案中,我们限制箭头长度为0.4 \ geq 0.4,并要求箭头在画布边缘处保持0.05\ eq 0.05。 这是因为箭头太短或压在边缘上很难读成方向提示,而且风和光箭可以在同一图像中共存,而固定颜色和尾巴/头部语义可以防止两者混淆.

blocks.en: Pose. Unlike other visual instructions, pose is specified not by coordinates but by adding a pose reference image. Pose references come from the curated pose pairs in VIBE ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) and are attached only when a person main reference is present. When a task has multiple person mains, we assign a pose reference to each and explicitly name the target person in the textual instruction. This avoids ambiguity about which person main a pose reference should apply to.
blocks.zh: Pose. 与其他视觉指示不同,姿势不是通过坐标来指定,而是通过添加姿势参考图像来指定. Pose参考来源于VIBE(Zhang et al., 2026a)中被曲解的姿势配对,仅在某人主要参考物出现时才附图. 当任务有多个人物主干线时,我们为每个任务指定一个姿势参照,并在文字指示中明确命名目标人物. 这避免了对哪些人应适用主要提法的含糊不清。

blocks.en: C.4 Conflict Detection
blocks.zh: C.4 冲突侦测

blocks.en:
Here we describe the algorithm we use to label the conflict tasks.
The procedure consists of three stages: pre-labeling on the reference pool side, per-task label matching, and evaluation of the conflict condition for each visual-instruction kind.
First, for every image in the reference pool, we use GPT-5 to pre-assign attribute labels needed for conflict detection, including the subject’s facing direction (yaw and the reliability of its estimate), the distinctiveness of the lighting (e.g., whether there is a special, colored, or localized light source), the wind responsiveness (whether the image contains elements such as hair, fabric, or smoke whose appearance changes under wind), and the distinctiveness of the pose (whether the subject is in a non-neutral pose with a clearly readable action).
Next, for each task, we read off the configuration of main references and visual instructions from the layout information and the reference hierarchy, and we link each main-reference image to its corresponding entry in the reference pool via hash matching, thereby making the pre-assigned attributes available for each main reference in the task.
Finally, for each visual instruction type included in the task, we evaluate the conditions described below; if at least one of the orientation, light, wind, or pose conditions is met, we label the task as the corresponding conflict task.
blocks.zh:
在这里,我们描述了我们用来标注冲突任务的算法。
该程序包括三个阶段:在参考池一侧预贴标签,每个任务标签匹配,以及评价每个视觉指令类型的冲突条件.
首先,对于参考池中的每一个图像,我们都会使用GPT-5预先指定冲突探测所需的属性标签,包括对象的面朝向(aw及其估计值的可靠性),照明的特性(例如是否有特殊的,有色的,或局部的光源),风能反应(图像中是否包含头发,织物等元素,或外观在风下变化的烟雾),以及姿势的独特性(无论主体是否处于非中性姿势,有明显的可读动作).
接下来,对于每项任务,我们从布局信息和参考层级中读取主要参考和视觉指示的配置,我们通过散列匹配将每个主要参考图像与其在参考集合中的相应条目联系起来,从而使任务中每个主要参考的预先指定属性可供使用.
最后,对于任务中包含的每个视觉指示类型,我们评价以下描述的条件;如果至少满足其中之一方向,光,风,或姿势条件,我们就将任务列为相应的冲突任务.

blocks.en:
Orientation conflict. An orientation conflict is declared when the subject in the reference image has a clear facing direction, and that direction disagrees with the direction specified by the visual instruction.
Concretely, we only enter the judgment when the facing direction estimated from the reference image (denoted source) is reliable, and we then compare it with the direction specified by the pyramid (denoted target). We declare a conflict when the minimum angular difference between source and target is ≥ 60 ∘ \geq 60^{\circ} , or when the two have opposite signs.
We include sign mismatch to capture left/right flips such as “the reference subject faces left, but the visual instruction specifies right.” This is needed because relying on the angular difference alone would miss cases such as yaw 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} and yaw − 20 ∘ -20^{\circ} : the difference is only 50 ∘ 50^{\circ} , but the left/right facing direction has actually flipped, and the appearance changes substantially.

Light conflict. Light conflict occurs when the reference image contains distinctive lighting that strongly shapes the scene’s appearance and the task includes a light arrow.
By distinctive lighting, we mean lighting that is clearly different from ordinary daylight or uniform indoor illumination, such as nighttime artificial light, neon, moonlight, window-beam light, spotlights, strong backlight, colored light, or any case where the lighting itself dominates the overall impression of the image.
blocks.zh:
轻冲突. 当参考图像包含显著的照明,强烈塑造场景外观,任务包括一个光箭头时,光冲突就会发生.
通过独特的照明,我们是指与普通的日光或统一的室内照明明显不同的照明,如夜间人工照明,霓虹灯,月光,窗梁照明,聚光灯,强背灯,彩色照明,或者任何照明本身主导画面整体印象的情况.

blocks.en:
Wind conflict. Wind conflict applies when the reference image contains elements whose appearance changes substantially with wind, and the task includes a wind arrow.
Such elements include hair, clothing, fur, feathers, fabric, paper, smoke, and flames, whose shapes or flows change with wind direction and strength.
blocks.zh:
风冲突. 当参考图像包含其外观随风而发生实质性变化的元素时,风冲突适用,任务包括风箭.
这类元素包括毛发,服装,毛皮,羽毛,织物,纸张,烟雾,以及火焰,其形状或流动随风向和强度而变化.

blocks.en:
Pose conflict. A pose conflict is declared when a person in the reference image is in a clear and distinctive pose, and a pose reference is attached to that person.
By distinctive pose, we mean a pose that is not neutral, such as a standing or front-facing still pose, but one in which the subject’s action or posture is clearly readable from the image. Note that pose reference images taken from VIBE are by construction intended to express explicit poses, and are therefore treated as distinctive poses by default.
blocks.zh:
庞斯冲突. 如果参考图像中的人具有明确和独特的姿势,并且该人附有姿势,则宣布存在冲突。
我们用独特的姿势表示一种不中立的姿势,如站立或正面姿态仍然摆着,但从形象上看,主题的行动或姿态是可以明显理解的。 请注意,从VIBE中提取的参考图像是用来表达明确面额的构造,因此默认被视为独特的面额。

blocks.en: Layout. A layout specifies a spatial arrangement over the whole scene rather than an intrinsic attribute of any reference image, so it is not subject to conflict detection.
blocks.zh: 版图 一种布局指定了整个场景的空间安排,而不是任何参考图像的内在属性,因此它不受冲突探测的影响.

blocks.en: C.5 Converting Visual Instructions into Text Instructions
blocks.zh: C.5 将视觉指示转化为文字指示

blocks.en:
Figure 8: Examples of converting visual instructions (VIs) into text instructions (TIs) at three levels of granularity.
From Dense to Sparse, information conveyed by the VI is progressively abstracted or removed.
For example, Orientation is simplified from explicit yaw/pitch values to “front-right, level” and then to “the viewer’s right,” while Pose is compressed from a detailed joint-level description to a short phrase capturing only its main configuration.

图8:将视觉指示(VIs)转化为文字指示(TIs),分三个颗粒级的例子.
从Dense到Sparse,VI传递的信息被逐渐抽象或删除.
例如,方向从明显的yaw/pitch值简化为 " 前端右侧,水平 " ,然后简化为 " 观众的右侧 " ,而Pose则从详细的联合级别描述压缩为只捕捉其主要配置的短短语。

blocks.en: Visual instructions (VIs), such as layout previews, 3D orientation pyramids, wind/light arrows, and pose references, provide a concise and intuitive way to specify spatial and directional constraints. Although the same constraints can in principle be expressed as text instructions (TIs), matching the precision of a VI may require explicitly verbalizing fine-grained information such as coordinates, viewing angles, and joint configurations. We therefore ask two questions: whether failures arise from the underlying constraint or from visual interpretation, and how the granularity of a textual description affects instruction following.
blocks.zh: 视觉指示(VIs),如布局预览,3D定向金字塔,风/光箭,以及姿势参考,提供了简洁直观的方式来指定空间和方向约束. 虽然原则上可以以文本指示(TIs)来表示同样的限制,但匹配VI的精度,可能要求明确用语言表达精细的信息,如坐标,查看角度,以及联合配置. 因此,我们提出两个问题:失败是源于根本限制,还是源于视觉解释,以及文字描述的颗粒性如何影响以下指示。

blocks.en: To this end, we replace each VI with one of three text variants: TI Dense , TI Medium , or TI Sparse . TI Dense preserves nearly all information in the original VI; TI Medium replaces exact numerical values with coarser discrete descriptions; and TI Sparse retains only the most salient spatial or directional attributes. Comparing VI with TI Dense approximately isolates the effect of modality under matched information content, while the three TI variants reveal how performance changes as textual specificity is reduced.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们将每个VI替换为三个文本变体之一:TI Dense,TI Medium,或TI Sparse. 东帝汶 Dense保存了原VI中几乎所有的信息;TI Medium用较短的离散描述取代精确的数值;TI Sparse只保留最显著的空间或方向属性. 将VI与TI Dense作比较,大约在匹配的信息内容下将模式的效果隔离开来,而三个TI变体则揭示了作为文本特异性的性如何降低性能变化.

blocks.en: All variants are constructed from the same 200-task subset, sampled with a fixed seed from tasks containing at least one non-layout VI and stratified to 50 tasks per subject count ( n = 1 n{=}1 – 4 4 ). The subset contains 96 tasks with an orientation instruction, 116 with a wind or light arrow, and 38 with a pose reference; every task contains a layout instruction. For each TI condition, we remove the corresponding VI images, re-index the remaining reference images, and remove the trailing clause asking the model to erase visual markings. Only the wording and granularity of the converted VI clauses differ across the three TI variants. Importantly, the judge is always given the original task with the original VI images and instruction, rather than the rewritten TI, so the scores measure adherence to the original visual constraint rather than agreement with a coarsened textual description.
blocks.zh: 所有变体都是由同一个200任务子集构建的,从至少包含一个非铺设VI的任务中以固定种子进行抽样,并分级为每个对象计数的50个任务(n = 1 n{=}1–4 4). 子集包含96项任务,带有方向指示,116项带有风或轻箭,38项带有姿势参考;每项任务包含布局指示. 对于每个TI条件,我们删除相应的VI图像,重新索引剩余的参考图像,并删除后缀条款,要求模型去除视觉标记. 只有转换后的VI条款的措辞和颗粒性在三个TI变式上有所不同. 重要的是,评委总是被赋予最初的任务,有原始的VI图像和指示,而不是重写TI,因此分数衡量的是对原始视觉约束的遵守程度,而不是一致的文本描述.

blocks.en: For layout, orientation, and arrow instructions, the underlying structured annotations—bounding boxes, yaw/pitch angles, and arrow endpoints— let us construct the TI variants deterministically using templates. This gives precise control over the information retained at each granularity and avoids conversion errors from a language model. Pose references are available only as images, so for each unique pose image we use a single GPT-5 vision call to jointly produce the TI Dense , TI Medium , and TI Sparse descriptions, keeping the three variants mutually consistent. Figure 8 illustrates how each VI is progressively abstracted across the three text variants.
blocks.zh: 对于布局、方向和箭头指示,基础结构的说明—— 边框、yaw/pitch角度和箭头端点—— 让我们用模板构建TI变体。 这样可以准确控制每个颗粒性保留的信息,避免语言模型的转换错误. Pose的参考文献仅作为图像提供,所以对于每个独特的姿势图像,我们使用一个单一的GPT-5视觉调用来联合制作TI Dense,TI Medium,和TI Sparse描述,保持三个变体相互一致. 图8说明每个VI是如何在三个文本变体中逐步抽象的。

blocks.en: This variant preserves as much information as possible from the original VI. For layout, it specifies the exact bounding box using corner coordinates as percentages of the canvas (e.g., “within the rectangular region from (13%, 8%) to (87%, 92%) of the canvas”). For orientation, it gives the exact yaw and pitch in degrees together with the sign convention. For arrows, it specifies the start and end points in canvas percentages and the heading angle; wind is described as blowing from the start point toward the end point, while light is described as arriving from the arrow’s origin. For pose, it provides a three-to-five-sentence joint-level description covering the torso, head, arms, and legs, including approximate angles and heights. TI Dense is thus the closest textual counterpart to the original VI, but requires information conveyed directly by the VI to be explicitly verbalized.
blocks.zh: 此变体从原始VI中尽可能保存信息. 对于布局,它规定使用角坐标的精确边框占画布的百分比(例如“从画布的13%、8%到(87%、92%)的长方形区域内”)。 对于定向,它给出了精确的 yaw 和投球的度 与标志的常规。 对于箭头,它以画布百分比和方向角来指定起始点和终点;风被描述为从起始点吹到终点,而光被描述为从箭头的源头传来. 就姿势而言,它提供了三至五级联合判决的描述,涵盖躯干、头部、手臂和腿部,包括大致角度和高度。 TI Dense因此是原VI最接近的文本对应,但要求由VI直接传递的信息被明确口头化.

blocks.en: This variant replaces continuous or fine-grained quantities with a small number of discrete categories. For layout, it specifies the 3 × 3 3{\times}3 grid cell containing the bounding-box center together with a three-level size label (small, medium, or large), while discarding the exact corners. Orientation is reduced to one of eight facing directions and three pitch levels. Arrow direction is quantized into eight compass directions, yielding descriptions such as “blowing from left to right” or “coming from the upper-left.” Pose is summarized in one or two sentences describing the torso, arms, and legs without numerical values. Compared with TI Dense , this representation is easier to specify but omits exact positions and angles.
blocks.zh: 这种变体用少量离散类别取代连续或精细的量. 对于布局,它指定了3×3 3 3\times}3 个网格单元格,其中包含边框中心以及一个三级大小标签(小,中,或大),同时丢弃准确的角. 方向缩小到8个正向方向和3个投球级别之一. 箭头方向被量化为八个指南针方向,产生诸如“从左到右吹来”或“从左上方飞来”等描述。 Pose以一两句概括,描述躯干,手臂和腿部没有数值. 与TI Dense(TI Dense)相比,这种表示比较容易指定,但省略了准确的位置和角度.

blocks.en: This variant retains only coarse spatial or directional information. Layout specifies only the horizontal third of the image—left, middle, or right—without vertical position or size. Orientation is reduced to four directions with no pitch information, and arrow direction to four cardinal directions. Pose is represented by a short phrase describing its main configuration, such as “one hand on hip, other arm extended.” TI Sparse substantially reduces textual complexity, but discards information such as box size, vertical position, fine-grained angles, and individual joint configurations.
blocks.zh: 该变体只保留粗细的空间或方向信息. 布局只指定图像的横向三分之一——左、中或右,没有垂直位置或大小。 方向减少为四个方向,没有投球信息,箭头方向减少为四个主方向. Pose用一个简短的短语来描述它的主要配置,例如“一只手放在臀部,另一只手臂伸展”。 TI Sparse大幅降低了文本的复杂性,但丢弃了框大小,垂直位置,细纹角度,以及单个联合配置等信息.

blocks.zh: 附录D 进一步统计

Figure 9: Reference adoption counts on the VIF-Bench evaluated set (1,241 tasks).
Each bar reports how many times a reference type is used, grouped into
Main Reference, Sub Reference, and Scene Context.
blocks.zh:
图 9: 参考通过数为受评价的VIF-Bench系列(1 241项任务)。
每个栏报告使用参考类型的次数,分类如下:
主要参考文献,分参考文献,以及场景背景.

blocks.en:
Figure 9 shows how often each reference type is adopted across the 1,241 tasks of our evaluated set, grouped into Main Reference, Sub Reference, and Scene Context and colored consistently with the reference-count distribution in Figure 3 .
Main references (the primary subjects) are adopted 564 times for person , 571 for animal , 1,413 for object , and 555 for text . The object count is larger than the others because, unlike the single-form person, animal, and text categories, objects are further split by their plausible placement environment into versatile (usable both indoors and outdoors), indoor-only , and outdoor-only ; the object bar therefore aggregates three sub-types, breaking down into 512 versatile, 459 indoor-only, and 442 outdoor-only adoptions. Consequently, person, animal, and text remain at a comparable scale (roughly 550–570 adoptions each), while object—being an umbrella over three environment-conditioned variants—accumulates a proportionally larger total.
Sub-references specify attributes of a main subject and are therefore tied to a specific main-subject type: on the person side we adopt clothes 65 times, grooming (hairstyle and make-up) 31 times, and facial expression 22 times; on the object side we adopt surface (color and material) 143 times; and on the text side text 91 times. Because each sub-reference type is only applicable to a compatible main subject—clothes, grooming, and facial expression apply to people, surface applies to objects, and text applies to text subjects—a sub-reference can be adopted only when the corresponding main type is present in the task. Consequently, the sub-reference counts are inherently uneven: they are upper-bounded by how often the associated main category appears (e.g., person for grooming, object for surface) and by whether a task chooses to specify that attribute. This subject-conditioned hierarchy also prevents semantically inconsistent task construction, such as assigning a facial-expression reference to an object.
Scene context, which specifies the overall appearance of the generated scene, is adopted 252 times for scene style and 149 for background .
blocks.zh:
图9显示,在我们评价的一组1,241项任务中,每个参考类型在多大程度上被采用,分为主要参考、次参考和场景背景,与图3中的参考数分布一致。
主要参考文献(主体)采用人564次,动物571次,物体1,413次,文字555次. 物体计数比其他的要大,因为与单形人、动物和文字类别不同的是,物体因其合理的放置环境而被进一步分割为多功能(室内和室外均可使用)、室内专用和室外专用;因此,物体栏汇总了三种子类型,细分为512个多功能型、459个室内专用和442个室外专用收养。 因此,人、动物和文字的规模仍然相当(大约每个收养550至570人),而作为伞形物体,在三种环境条件的变体之上,则累积了比例较大的总数。
子引用指定了主体的属性,因此与特定的主体类型联系在一起:在人物方面,我们采用服装65次,梳理(发型和化妆)31次,面部表情22次;在物体方面,我们采用表面(颜色和材料)143次;在文字边文本91次. 由于每个子引用类型仅适用于一个相容的主主体——布衣,梳理,和面部表情适用于人,表面适用于对象,文本适用于文本主体——只有当任务中存在相应的主类型时才能采用子引用. 因此,次引用计数在本质上是不均匀的:它们上方是相关主要类别(如培养对象,表面对象)的出现频率以及任务是否选择指定该属性. 这种带有主题条件的等级结构也防止了在任务构建上明显不一致,例如给一个物体分配面部表情参考.

blocks.en: Appendix E Comparison with Prior Works
blocks.zh: 附录E 与以往工程的比较

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares benchmarks by the maximum number of visual-instruction images provided within a single task.
This image-level definition is distinct from the semantic number of visual operations encoded in those images.
In VIBE ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , multiple visual operations may be combined within a single annotated image in its multi-task setting; we therefore count it as one visual-instruction image at the image level, rather than treating it as semantically containing only a single instruction.
MultiRef ( Chen et al., 2025a ) supports multiple reference images, but each task uses at most a single visual-instruction image.
DreamOmni3 ( Xia et al., 2025a ) can involve up to two scribble-annotated images in a task, but these use a single scribble-based instruction modality rather than multiple heterogeneous visual-instruction types.
VIF-Bench instead requires models to jointly process multiple independent reference images together with multiple visual-instruction images, integrating heterogeneous constraints such as layout, orientation, pose, wind, and lighting.
blocks.zh:
表1按一项任务中提供的视觉指示图像的最大数量比较基准。
这种图像级别的定义与这些图像中编码的视觉操作的语义数量是不同的.
在VIBE(Zhang等人,2026a)中,多个视觉操作可能在其多任务设定中在一个附加说明的图像内合并;因此我们把它算作图像层面的一个视觉指示图像,而不是把它当作只包含一个指令的标本.
MultiRef (Chen et al., 2025a) 支持多个参考图像,但每项任务最多使用单个视觉指示图像.
DreamOmni3(Xia等人,2025a)在一项任务中可以涉及最多两个拼写附加说明的图像,但这些图像使用单一拼写式的指令模式,而不是多种不同的视觉指令类型.
而VIF-Bench则需要模型联合处理多个独立参考图像与多个视觉引导图像,整合布局,方向,姿势,风,照明等多种制约.

blocks.en:
Beyond comparison in Table 1 , we also examine how recent state-of-the-art image generators perform on an existing multi-reference benchmark.
We evaluate Nano Banana Pro and GPT-Image-1.5 on MultiRef ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , which assesses heterogeneous visual-reference conditions using three Overall Assessment dimensions: Image Quality (IQ), Instruction Following (IF), and Source Fidelity (SF).
As shown in Table 5 , GPT-Image-1.5 achieves an average score of 0.848, exceeding the 0.771 score of the ground-truth images under MultiRef’s Overall Assessment protocol.
This suggests that the current MultiRef evaluation provides relatively limited headroom for distinguishing the strongest recent generators.
These quantitative findings are echoed by qualitative inspection ( Figure 10 ).
blocks.zh:
除了表1的比较之外,我们还审查最近最先进的图像生成器如何在现有多参考基准下运作。
我们评价了Nano Banana Pro和GPT-Image-1.5的多参考文献(Chen等人,2025年a),其中利用三个总体评估维度评估了各种视觉参考条件:图像质量(IQ)、跟随指示(IF)和来源Fidelity(SF)。
如表5所示,GPT-Image-1.5的平均得分为0.848,超过了MultiRef总体评估协议下的地面真实图像的0.771分。
这表明,目前的多参考评价为区分最近的最强发电机提供了相对有限的头室。
定性检查也反映了这些定量调查结果(图10)。

blocks.en: Appendix F Further Results
blocks.zh: 附录F 结果

blocks.en: F.1 Further Results for Reference–Visual-Instruction Conflict
blocks.zh: F.1 参考-视觉-指导冲突的进一步结果

blocks.en:
We provide a more detailed analysis of reference–visual-instruction conflict across all evaluated generators.
Among the 1,241 tasks in VIF-Bench, 438 contain at least one conflict between an attribute implied by a reference image and a visual instruction controlling the same attribute, while 803 contain no such conflict.
At the instruction-type level, conflicts occur in 106 of the 315 Orientation tasks (33.7%), 172 of the 233 Light tasks (73.8%), 153 of the 250 Wind tasks (61.2%), and 82 of the 141 Pose tasks (58.2%).
These categories are not mutually exclusive, since a single task may contain conflicts for multiple visual-instruction types.
blocks.zh:
我们更详细地分析所有评估发电机的参考-视觉指示冲突。
在VIF-Bench的1,241项任务中,438项包含至少一个参考图像暗示的属性与控制同一属性的视觉指令之间的冲突,而803项则包含没有这种冲突.
在教学类型方面,在315项定向任务中的106项(33.7%)、233项轻任务中的172项(73.8%)、250项风力任务中的153项(61.2%)和141项波斯任务中的82项(58.2%)发生了冲突。
这些类别并非相互排斥,因为一项单一任务可能包含多种视觉教学类型的冲突。

blocks.en:
Figure 11 extends the analysis in Figure 6 ( Left ) to all eight generators and all evaluation criteria. For each visual-instruction type, we split the corresponding tasks into conflict and no-conflict subsets and report the average score on each criterion for each generator. Below, we focus on Visual Instruction Adherence (third row), the criterion directly targeted by the conflict.
The full results show that the effect of conflict depends strongly on the controlled attribute.
For Orientation, adherence is lower on the conflict subset for every generator, although the gap is relatively modest.
The effect is substantially larger for Light and Wind: all eight generators obtain lower adherence on conflict tasks, indicating that salient lighting conditions or wind-responsive appearance already present in a reference can strongly interfere with the corresponding visual instruction.
blocks.zh:
图11将图6(左)中的分析扩展到所有8台发电机和所有评价标准。 对于每个视觉指令类型,我们把相应的任务分成冲突和无冲突子集,并报告每个生成器在每个标准上的平均分数. 下面我们着重讨论视觉指示遵守(第三行),这是冲突直接针对的标准。
全面结果显示,冲突的影响在很大程度上取决于受控的属性。
就定向而言,每个生成器对冲突子集的坚持度较低,尽管差距相对较小。
光和风效应要大得多:所有8台发电机对冲突任务的坚持度都较低,这表明参考文献中已经存在的突出的照明条件或风能外观会强烈干扰相应的视觉指示。

blocks.en:
The raw per-generator scores further show that this effect is not simply driven by a particular model family.
For Light, the conflict–no-conflict decrease ranges from approximately 0.78 to 1.85 points across the eight generators, while for Wind it ranges from approximately 0.51 to 1.86 points.
For Orientation, the decrease is smaller, ranging from approximately 0.08 to 0.68 points.
A simple average over the eight per-generator scores gives conflict versus no-conflict adherence of 2.77 versus 3.08 for Orientation, 3.46 versus 4.67 for Light, and 2.99 versus 4.43 for Wind.
blocks.zh:
原始的每生成者得分进一步表明,这种效果并非仅仅是由特定的模型家族驱动的.
就Light而言,冲突-非冲突减少的八台发电机的点数大约为0.78至1.85,而Wind则大约为0.51至1.86。
就方向而言,下降幅度较小,从0.08到0.68点不等。
简单平均而言,在每代人得分的8分中,冲突与无冲突的比例为:定向为2.77比3.08,光明为3.46比4.67,风为2.99比4.43。

blocks.en:
Pose exhibits a different pattern.
The effect is more model-dependent: Nano Banana, Nano Banana Pro, and GPT-Image-1.5 show lower adherence on pose-conflict tasks, whereas several open-weight models show little difference or a small change in the opposite direction.
These open-weight models score near the floor on pose tasks in both subsets, so the absence of a gap likely reflects a floor effect rather than robustness to conflict.
Accordingly, averaging across all eight generators yields only a small aggregate difference for Pose (3.11 versus 3.17).
This suggests that reference–visual-instruction interference is particularly systematic for Light and Wind, while the effect of a conflicting reference pose depends more strongly on the generator.
blocks.zh:
Pose表现出不同的模式。
这种效果更依赖模型:纳诺香蕉、纳诺香蕉Pro和GPT-Image-1.5对假冒冲突任务的遵守程度较低,而几个开放量级模型显示差异不大,或者相反方向略有变化。
这些开放式模型在地板附近得分,在两个子集中都构成任务,因此没有差距可能反映冲突产生的底线效应而不是强力。
因此,所有八台发电机的平均数对Pose来说只产生很小的总差(3.11对3.17)。
这表明参考-视觉指示干扰对光和风特别系统,而相互冲突的参考作用则更取决于生成者。

blocks.en: Figure 11: Full per-generator analysis of reference–visual-instruction conflict. For each visual-instruction type (columns), we compare conflict (hatched) and no-conflict subsets across all eight generators on the six evaluation criteria and their average (rows). On Visual Instruction Adherence (third row), conflict consistently reduces scores for Orientation, Light, and Wind, with substantially larger gaps for Light and Wind, whereas the effect for Pose is more model-dependent.
blocks.zh: 图11:参考-视听指示冲突的全面逐源分析。 对于每个视觉指示类型(列),我们比较所有8个发电机的冲突(夹)和无冲突子集在6个评价标准及其平均值(数列)上. 在视觉指令遵守(第三行)方面,冲突持续减少方向、轻度和风度的分数,轻度和风度的分数差距要大得多,而波斯的效果则更依赖模型。

blocks.en: F.2 Further Results for the Number of References and Visual Instructions
blocks.zh: F.2 参考文献和视觉指导数量的进一步结果

blocks.en:
Figure 12 extends Figure 5 to all generators and all criteria, together with their average.
As in Section 4.2 , tasks are binned by the number of reference images or visual-instruction images.
blocks.zh:
图12将图5及其平均数扩展到所有发电机和所有标准。
与第4.2节一样,任务由参考图像或视觉指示图像的数量来表示。

blocks.en:
Every generator scores lower with five or more references than with one on every criterion except Visual Instruction Cleanliness.
Reference Consistency separates the two model groups most clearly: the open-weight generators start relatively close to the closed ones with a single reference but fall to near the floor with five or more, whereas the closed generators decline only moderately.
Since the judge assigns the minimum Reference Consistency score whenever any subject is missing or replaced (Appendix J ), these near-floor scores suggest that, according to the judges, at least one referenced subject is missing or replaced in most of these outputs.
Visual Instruction Adherence for the open-weight generators likewise falls near the floor.
Text Instruction Following, in contrast, drops by a similar amount in both groups, so its open/closed gap remains roughly constant.
Visual Quality of the closed generators stays high in every bin, and Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 is the only generator whose Visual Quality collapses.
Its successor, Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, starts at a similar level but declines only moderately, so the Visual Quality gain from 2509 to 2511 in Table 2 arises largely from multi-reference tasks.
Scene Coherence declines for all generators, more steeply for the Nano Banana models than for the GPT-Image models.
blocks.zh:
除了视觉指示清洁性以外,每个生成器的分数都低于每个标准的5个或5个以上参考数。

由于每当任何科目缺失或被替换时,法官都会分配最低参考一致性分数(附录J),这些近底分数表明,法官认为,在这些产出中,大多数产出中至少缺失或替换一个参考科目。

blocks.en:
Visual Instruction Cleanliness follows family-dependent trends that connect to the adherence–artifact trade-off in Section 4.1 .
With a single reference, the closed generators are nearly tied in Visual Instruction Adherence, and all keep Cleanliness high.
With five or more references, they split into two groups: the Nano Banana models retain higher adherence but leave more instruction marks, whereas the GPT-Image models remain clean but lose much of their adherence.
The trade-off among closed models thus emerges as references accumulate.
For the open-weight generators, Cleanliness is instead higher with five or more references than with one.
Because this increase coincides with near-floor adherence, it suggests that their outputs neither follow nor reproduce the visual instructions, but rather than following them cleanly.
blocks.zh:
视觉指导 清洁遵循家庭依赖性的趋势,这些趋势与第4.1节中的艺术取舍相联。
仅举一例,闭合的发电机几乎被绑在视觉指令的遵守中,并且都保持高清.
有5个或更多的参考文献,它们被分成两组:纳诺香蕉模型保持较高的坚持度,但留下更多的指示标记,而GPT-Image模型仍然保持干净,但却失去了大部分坚持度.
因此,随着参考文献的积累,封闭模型之间出现了权衡。
对于露天重量的发电机来说,清洁性却更高,有5个或更多参考文献,而不是1个参考文献。
由于这种增加与接近地板的遵守同时发生,它表明其产出既不遵循也不复制视觉指示,而是不完全遵循这些指示.

blocks.en:
Compared with references, the number of visual instructions has a weaker effect.
From one to three visual instructions, the Average score decreases for every generator, but always less than it does over the same increase in references; the two effects are closest for Nano Banana Pro and the GPT-Image models.
For every generator, Visual Instruction Adherence changes only slightly and far less than with references, even though the judge caps adherence by the worst violation among all visual instructions (Appendix J ).
Instead, Text Instruction Following, Reference Consistency, Scene Coherence, and Visual Quality decrease for every generator, typically most in Text Instruction Following and Scene Coherence.
Visual Instruction Cleanliness moves in both directions: it drops for Nano Banana Pro and Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 but rises for DreamOmni2 and FLUX.1 Kontext.
The 4+ bin contains few tasks and shows large model-dependent deviations in both directions; for example, the Average score drops for GPT-Image-1 but rises for GPT-Image-1.5.
blocks.zh:
与参考文献相比,视觉指示的数量效果较弱.
从1到3个视觉指令,每个生成器的平均分数都会下降,但总是低于参考数的同样增加;纳诺香蕉Pro和GPT-Image模型的两种效果最接近.
对每个生成器来说,视觉指令遵守率的变化仅略微小于参考文献,尽管法官将所有视觉指令中最恶劣的违反情况限定为遵守(附录J)。
相反,每个生成器的文本指令、参考一致性、场景一致性和视觉质量都有所下降,这主要是在文本指令跟踪和场景一致性方面。

blocks.en: F.3 Further Results for Visual vs. Text-Converted Instructions
blocks.zh: F.3 视觉对文本转换指令的进一步结果

blocks.en:
Figure 13 reports the full results for Nano Banana Pro and GPT-Image-1.5 across all evaluation criteria. Unlike Nano Banana Pro, whose Visual Instruction Adherence is highest with the original VI, GPT-Image-1.5 has relatively weak VI adherence and benefits from converting the same constraints into text.
Even for GPT-Image-1.5, the most detailed TI Dense is not optimal: TI Medium achieves the highest VI/TI Instruction Adherence, suggesting that, for this model, moderately abstracted descriptions are easier to follow than either the visual instructions or exhaustive textual ones.
For the remaining metrics, performance generally improves as the instruction becomes less restrictive, reflecting greater freedom to preserve reference content and overall image quality. Visual Instruction Cleanliness also increases substantially when moving from VI to TI, as the visual instruction images—and hence the marks that could be reproduced in the output—are no longer provided. Importantly, we evaluate all generations using the VLM judges against the original task , including its original VI images, rather than against the converted TI. We use the original VI as the oracle specification so that the comparison measures how well each textual representation recovers the constraint encoded by the VI, rather than how well the output matches a potentially coarsened textual instruction.

即使对于GPT-Image-1.5,最详细的TI Dense也并非最佳: TI Medium实现最高的VI/TI指令的遵守,表明对于这个模型来说,略抽象的描述比视觉指令或详尽的文字指令更容易遵循.

To further validate the Visual Quality evaluation, we compare the
VLM-based scores with conventional image-quality predictors.
Specifically, we compute correlations with LAION Aesthetic Predictor (AP) v1 and v2 ( LAION-AI, 2022 ) over 168 generated images. Table 8 reports the PLCC and SRCC for GPT-5, Gemini, Qwen3-VL-32B, and human Visual Quality ratings.

blocks.en: G.5 Diversity under Repeated Generation
blocks.zh: G.5 世代相传的多样性

blocks.en:
The primary VIF-Bench evaluation measures whether a generated image
satisfies its references and instructions, but does not directly measure
variation across repeated generations.
To examine this aspect, we select 12 tasks and generate five outputs for
each task and model using identical references and instructions.
Following Kim et al. (2025) , we measure diversity among repeated outputs using the mean pairwise CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) distance and mean pairwise LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) .
The tasks are grouped by the number of major visual instructions,
denoted by N VI N_{\mathrm{VI}} .
blocks.zh:
主要VIF-Bench评价衡量是否生成图像
满足其参考和指示,但不直接计量
世代相传的差异。
为了审查这一方面,我们选择了12项任务,并产生了5项产出。
每个任务和模式使用相同的参考和指示。
继Kim等人(2025年)之后,我们使用平均对偶的CLIP(Radford等人,2021年)距离和平均对偶的LPIPS(Zhang等人,2018年)测量重复产出的多样性。
各项任务按主要视觉指示的数量分类,
由NVI N_{\mathrm{VI}}表示.

blocks.en:
Overall, variation across repeated generations tends to increase as the
number of visual constraints grows, while the Average Score decreases.
For Nano Banana Pro, for example, CLIP diversity increases from 0.078 at N VI = 1 N_{\mathrm{VI}}=1 to 0.216 at N VI = 4 N_{\mathrm{VI}}=4 , while the Average
Score decreases from 7.74 to 6.48.
GPT-Image-1.5 remains comparatively stable for N VI ≤ 3 N_{\mathrm{VI}}\leq 3 , but at N VI = 4 N_{\mathrm{VI}}=4 its diversity
increases and its Average Score drops substantially.
Importantly, greater variation is not necessarily desirable in the
strongly constrained setting considered by VIF-Bench.
When all reference and visual-instruction constraints are satisfied,
repeated outputs are expected to remain within a relatively restricted
set of valid solutions.
As task complexity increases, different generations may instead violate
different subsets of the constraints, causing the outputs to diverge in
different directions.
The observed increase in diversity may therefore reflect generation
instability rather than useful creative variation.
Distinguishing diversity that preserves instruction fidelity from
variation caused by inconsistent constraint satisfaction remains an
important direction for future evaluation.

blocks.en: Instruction-based image editing can be viewed as one of the earliest forms of reference-conditioned image generation, where the source image serves as a dense reference whose content must be preserved except for the instructed change. Benchmarks in this line, including MagicBrush ( Zhang et al., 2023a ) , EMU-Edit ( Sheynin et al., 2024 ) , SmartEdit ( Huang et al., 2024b ) , I2E-Bench ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , and ImgEdit ( Ye et al., 2025 ) , accordingly assume a single reference image and a textual edit instruction, and therefore do not address compositional multi-reference settings. Table 11 shows further comparison with prior benchmarks.
